svg.data-poe: IEEE 802.3af/802.3at on all 48 RJ45 ports, up to 30 W per port, 820 W system budget
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER/ZR (datasheet Compatible Transceivers; 80 km / 1G-10G per HIG Port Overview)
svg.data-usb: 1 x USB 1.0 Type-A port (datasheet wording; HIG cabling says USB 2.0 - see gaps)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035

rect.data-members: port-48 port-49 port-50 port-51 port-52 port-53 port-54 port-55

g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table, left lamp - Off (no power), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity)
g.title: led-mgmt-left

g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table, right lamp - Off (no power), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity)
g.title: led-mgmt-right

g.data-description: toggles every network-port lamp between LNK/SPD and PoE status (HIG LED table footnote); the hardware is a raised rubber dome, drawn with the recessed-pinhole part - see provenance
g.title: mode

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Blinking Green (system is booting), Solid Yellow (DIAG OS boot complete)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (fans are not initialized), Solid Green (all fans work normal), Blinking Yellow (fan fail: one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PS0 row - Solid Green (PSU0 working normal), Blinking Yellow (PSU0 fail, needs service); the table lists no Off row for the PSU lamps, the dark state exists physically
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PS1 row - Solid Green (PSU1 working normal), Blinking Yellow (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG LNK/SPD row - Off (POE mode), Solid Green (LED on each network port indicates the link & speed status)
g.title: led-lnk-spd

g.data-description: HIG POE row - Off (Link/Speed mode), Solid Green (LED on each network port indicates the PoE status)
g.title: led-poe

g.data-description: HIG ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature is enabled on the switch)
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: the 48 10M/100M/1G RJ45 access ports, PoE 802.3af/at up to 30 W each; the hardware carries one mode-switched lamp per jack, the part draws both corner windows (led-a/led-b of common/rj45-ganged-eth@1) at the component default, and the port-leds provenance records the mismatch
